about: The MCP's test suites, once each (G1, 0.3.1); each with the name its result line prints and, on test.mjs, sharded (its parts run in CI's shards 1-N, it says SKIP in shard 0) (A2). npm test runs them in this order through run-tests.mjs; npm test -- <area> runs one area. scripts/ci-sum.mjs, scripts/check-result-lines.mjs and CI's shard 0 read this file. Every test-*.mjs in mcp/ is in suites or in ignored (with why); pending holds a suite that is coming (move it into suites when its file lands).

areas.core: Every tool end to end, the golden tasks, cross-cutting sweeps
areas.safety: Safety and approval: the gate, the approval page, writes, the screen
areas.model: Reading models and reports, model health, large models
areas.report: Report writing, layout, design options and the preview
areas.twin: The Arabic twin, the EN-AR copy and the bilingual report
areas.release: Packaging, release text and public claims

affected.about: npm test -- --affected (A2, 0.3.1; local runs only, CI and the final gate run every suite): a changed path picks its own suite, or nothing (none), or every suite (everything: the safety infrastructure, the server, the harness, the fixtures, public text several areas read), or its areas (areas); a path in none of these picks every suite. A pattern ending in / is a folder, * matches within a name; paths from the repo root.
